question:
Find the value of x in the following equation:

 [1+{{ 1over {1+{1over {1+{1over 5}}}}} }] ÷ 1{6over 11} = {xover 2}
solution:
**Given:**

⇒ [1+{{ 1over {1+{1over {1+{1over 5}}}}} }]÷ 1{6over 11} = {xover 2} 

**Concept Used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

**Calculations:**

[1+{{ 1over {1+{1over {1+{1over 5}}}}} }] ÷(1 + 6/11) = x/2

⇒ [1+{{ 1over {1+{5over {6}}}} }] ÷ (1 + 6/11) = x/2

⇒ [1 + 6/11] ÷ 17/11 = x/2 

⇒ 17/11 ÷ 17/11 = x/2

⇒ x = 1 × 2 = 2

**∴ The value of x in the given equation is 2.**
